name: fight-academy-platform
description: FightAcademy gym platform: Angular front-end + Express/PostgreSQL back-end

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix back-end install && npm --prefix front-end/front-end install
scripts.build: npm --prefix back-end run build && npm --prefix front-end/front-end run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix back-end test && npm --prefix front-end/front-end test -- --watch=false
scripts.format: npm --prefix back-end run format && npm --prefix front-end/front-end exec -- prettier --write "src/**/*.{ts,html,css}"
